devices.title: Apple device readiness
devices.sub: For teams with Macs, iPhones and iPads
devices.intro: Seven practices that keep a small fleet manageable. Answer for how things work today.
qs: You can list every device and who has it.
Netquor Fleet enrolls Macs, iPhones and iPads and shows you everything in one inventory.
New devices are set up from a standard configuration, not by hand.
Fleet applies settings through configuration profiles, so a new device starts the same way as the last one.
Staff can install approved apps without asking you.
Fleet includes a self-service app library, so people install what you approve in one click.
Operating system and app updates happen on a schedule you control.
Fleet handles patching on your schedule.
You can block software that should not run.
Fleet can block restricted software and apply vendor app policies.
You can run a script or install a package on a device without visiting it.
Fleet runs scripts and installs packages remotely, with clean uninstalls.
VPN and Wi-Fi settings reach devices without touching each one.
Fleet can push Wi-Fi, VPN and WireGuard tunnel configuration to the devices you choose.

calls.title: Call handling readiness
calls.sub: For owners who miss calls while working
calls.intro: Seven practices for making sure a caller reaches someone or gets an answer.
qs: Every business call is answered or returned the same day.
Netquor Phone answers calls and takes messages. It is in early access and not billed yet.
After-hours callers get an answer or can leave a message.
Netquor Phone can answer after hours with an AI receptionist, in early access.
You know what each caller wanted without listening to every voicemail.
Netquor Phone tells you what each caller needed. Summaries arrive by email with a transcript, and text summaries are in preview.
Callers reach the right person or department.
Netquor Phone has extensions, desk phones and call flows you draw.
A second person can pick up when you cannot.
Netquor Phone can route calls to other people and queues.
You keep a record of missed calls and callbacks.
A call log shows who called and when, so nothing depends on memory.
Your number stays yours if you change provider.
Number porting is part of onboarding for Netquor Phone.

network.title: Network and remote access readiness
network.sub: For offices, labs and anyone hosting from home
network.intro: Seven practices for a network you can see, secure and reach from anywhere.
qs: You can list every device on your network.
Netquor SDN gives managed networks centralized monitoring.
Guest, staff and device traffic are on separate networks.
Netquor SDN automates Ubiquiti UniFi networks and VyOS routing and firewall rules.
Remote access uses a VPN, not open ports.
Netquor VPN is a local WireGuard VPN with plans from 25 Mbps to 1 Gbps.
You have a public IP address you control for hosting.
Network Solutions gives you a routable IPv4 and an IPv6 /56 over WireGuard, from our own network.
Your firewall rules are written down and reviewed.
Netquor SDN covers VyOS routing and firewall configuration.
Someone notices when something goes down.
Your router and switch configuration is backed up.
Netquor SDN automates configuration and has an API.

people.title: People and access readiness
people.sub: For teams on Google Workspace, and for buildings
people.intro: Seven practices for starting and stopping access without hunting through tools.
qs: Adding a person updates every system from one place.
Netquor Central keeps your directory and Google Workspace in step. It is in development.
A leaver loses access the same day.
Netquor Central reacts when people join, move or leave. Cutting off sign-in after a last day is still being finished.
Email signatures are consistent and updated automatically.
Netquor Central builds signatures from directory fields.
Group membership is managed in one place, not in each tool.
Netquor Central manages directory groups and syncs them to Google Groups.
Inbox filters and labels are shared across the organization.
Netquor Central defines Gmail filters and labels once and applies them to everyone or chosen groups.
Door access can be changed without replacing hardware.
Digital Access keeps many existing call boxes and systems and adds mobile entry.
Visitors and guests can be given temporary access.
Digital Access supports guest and visitor access.
